title: Los Alamos disinformation as a model for secret programs

tellings.quote: You have duplicitous filings. For example, they didn't want people to know that plutonium and uranium were the two main radioactive elements that they were focused on.

plain: During the 1940s, the secret lab at Los Alamos, New Mexico, where the atomic bomb was built, made misleading filings so that no one would learn that plutonium and uranium were the two radioactive elements it was focused on. The mathematician Eric Weinstein tells this without naming a source, linking it to the chemist Harold Urey, as a model for how secret programs today may hide what they are really working on.
